question: When was the 56th meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4, 5 and 6 August 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **56th meeting** of the **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)** is scheduled to be held over three days on **4, 5 and 6 August 2025**.
 
• This meeting is part of the **bi-monthly** review cycle conducted by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** for the financial year **2025-26**.
 
• The primary function of this **56th meeting** is to deliberate on the prevailing **macroeconomic conditions** and decide the appropriate **Policy Repo Rate** to maintain **price stability**.
 
• As per the statutory provisions, the **MPC** must meet at least **four times** a year, although the **RBI** typically schedules **six meetings** annually to ensure responsive monetary policy.
